note: construct-plain and merge-write-many showed NO separation under the known-bad arm, so this harness has no authority over them; a candidate result on those ops is INCONCLUSIVE by construction.

decision.GREEN: median delta within the A/A envelope for that op AND blocksSlower not systematically >15/20
decision.RED: median delta separates in the regression direction beyond the A/A p90 AND blocksSlower >=16/20, i.e. resembling the known-bad signature
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: anything between, or any result on a non-authoritative op
